title: MYTH BUSTER CONTINUATION — JANUS / Vault 87 Dual-Witness Threshold
scope: Investigate the secret of Vault 87, the refusal of the founding Little Lamplighters at its back door, the documented two-way audibility across the boundary, and structural correspondences with already-existing JANUS Meta Registry artifacts.

vault87_secret.name: Evolutionary Experimentation Program
vault87_secret.core_mechanism: Human Vault residents were used as test subjects for modified Forced Evolutionary Virus strains intended to produce useful accelerated physical adaptations, including combat-relevant changes.
observed_cycle: brain-function failure in at least one subject
thicker and more resilient skin by day 10
severe rage and anxiety by day 14
new strain and new subjects introduced

institutional_secrecy.medical_record_rule: Deaths associated with the special EEP section were to be coded as undefined or unexplained and questions were discouraged.
institutional_secrecy.interpretation: The final-game terminal records explicitly document concealment/obfuscation of EEP-linked deaths inside Vault 87.

engineering_whistleblower.finding: Koster reports dead or missing residents, unexplained deaths, obstruction from Medical Records, and something seriously wrong in the EEP section.

outside.role: ten-year-old founding Little Lamplighter and future first mayor
outside.witness: The children bang on the Vault-side door, are refused entry, can hear people inside, and receive one verbal response that they are already dead.

inside.witness: Peter records that in the outer tunnels he repeatedly hears children's laughter while Vault doctors attribute it to his grief and loss of Jason.

dead_inside.eep_relation: UD000 was the code mandated for special-EEP-section deaths; this makes Jason Stevens strongly implicated in the concealed EEP death system, although an individual experiment record naming his exact exposure was not found in the reviewed material.

basis: Peter works in/near the Vault 87 outer-tunnel/reactor-side area adjacent to the Little Lamplight route.
Peter independently records hearing children's laughter in the outer tunnels.
His grief centers on his dead son Jason, and Vault doctors tell him the children's sounds are hallucinations caused by that loss.

institutional_context.claim_ceiling: The reviewed game text does not explicitly state that the children were refused specifically to protect EEP secrecy.

door_and_acoustic_forensics.little_lamplight_access: A secondary/back access route in the cavern/outer-tunnel system; a wall terminal is identified as Vault-Tec Remote Access Terminal 07b and can engage/disengage the door lock.
door_and_acoustic_forensics.documented_outside_to_inside_signal: Peter Stevens hears children's laughter in the outer tunnels.
door_and_acoustic_forensics.documented_inside_to_outside_signal: Jason Grant says the children can hear people in the Vault and that a man once answered them.
possible_nonexclusive_channels: airborne sound through door seams or adjoining service geometry
door_and_acoustic_forensics.engineering_conclusion: The lore requires an acoustic/communication path across the back-door boundary but does not identify the exact physical channel; describing this specific boundary as perfectly soundproof or hermetic goes beyond the evidence.

final_game: Peter's personal journals identify his dead son Jason and his wife.
medical records list Jason Stevens as deceased under UD000.
Peter records hearing children's laughter in outer tunnels.
Jason Grant records reciprocal audibility from Little Lamplight.
final_vs_cut_content_boundary.cut_content_conflict: An inaccessible cut overseer dossier claims Peter had no recorded wife or child and treats him as delusional.
final_vs_cut_content_boundary.interpretation: The contradiction is preserved as software/lore archaeology, not used to erase the final-game Jason Stevens record.

fawkes_identity_parallel.game_fact: Fawkes retains fragments of familiarity and memory associated with Vault 87 while his former human identity is largely lost after mutation.

comparison_to_harkness.Harkness: identity and face are deliberately rewritten; buried prior identity can be restored
comparison_to_harkness.Fawkes: identity is involuntarily disrupted by biological transformation; fragments of prior memory remain

fawkes_identity_parallel.janus_interpretation: Two Fallout 3 storylines independently explore a person crossing an identity threshold while the previous self is not completely erased.

meta_registry_crosslinks.vault87_mapping: The Vault 87/Little Lamplight door is a literal threshold with independently preserved testimony on both sides.

meta_registry_crosslinks.relation: External witness is invited with independent scales; negative or disagreeing evidence remains admissible.
meta_registry_crosslinks.vault87_mapping: Narrative inversion: the children are an external signal/witness at the door, but the institution does not admit them and Peter's evidence is medicalized rather than independently checked.

meta_registry_crosslinks.relation: The adult must arrive before chronic danger forces the child to become their own armor.
meta_registry_crosslinks.vault87_mapping: Little Lamplight is an almost literal inversion: adults disappear or refuse entry, so children build their own protected society, rules and leadership.

meta_registry_crosslinks.relation: Separate signal, interpretation and response; distress is data before judgment.
meta_registry_crosslinks.vault87_mapping: Peter receives a real child-signal, but the available institutional interpretation labels it grief compensation/hallucination, leading to a failed response.

meta_registry_crosslinks.relation: January -> Janus symbolic provenance with an explicit rule that meaningful coincidence must not be promoted into unrelated proof.
meta_registry_crosslinks.vault87_mapping: The January Little Lamplight object may be retained as a real Janus naming/threshold association while remaining insufficient to prove Bethesda authorial intent.

meta_registry_crosslinks.relation: Independent witnesses, external anchors and negative controls matter more than narrative certainty.
meta_registry_crosslinks.vault87_mapping: Jason Grant and Peter Stevens form a rare two-sided witness pair: each independently records information crossing the same boundary from the opposite direction.

meta_registry_crosslinks.relation: A claimed isolation boundary must account for every information path that crosses it.
meta_registry_crosslinks.vault87_mapping: Vault 87 is institutionally sealed, yet audible information crosses its Little Lamplight/outer-tunnel boundary; the acoustic path is therefore a real boundary channel even though its exact mechanism is unknown.

meta_registry_crosslinks.relation: No person or living value should be reduced to property, resource, instrument or coercive object.
meta_registry_crosslinks.vault87_mapping: EEP reduces residents to numbered experimental subjects and conceals deaths; this is an ethical inversion of the registry's anti-enslavement/anti-instrumentalization principle.

meta_registry_crosslinks.relation: Harkness old/new identity and memory/face transition.
meta_registry_crosslinks.vault87_mapping: Fawkes provides a second Fallout 3 identity-transition case where old memory survives only in fragments after transformation.

strongest_new_forensic_pattern.name: DUAL_WITNESS_WITH_GRIEF_PRIOR
strongest_new_forensic_pattern.importance: This structure is anchored by independent records on opposite sides of the boundary and therefore is stronger than a one-sided thematic coincidence.
not_claimed: that Peter is explicitly named by the game as the man who answered Jason Grant
that EEP secrecy is explicitly stated as the reason the children were rejected
that Bethesda intentionally encoded a Janus myth
that the sound passed through the giant main Vault blast door
that an intercom is confirmed at the Little Lamplight door
